result.user: Explain how vaccines work so my five-year-old would get it. If you do not have a mode for talking to little kids, ask Claude to build one first.
result.reply:
Imagine your body is like a castle with guards called **Immune Cells**! 🏰

But sometimes, mean germs come to visit! 😱 The germs have sharp claws and can scratch you! Yuck!

So, we put on our shieldy shield called a **Vaccine**! 🛡️

A vaccine isn't just any old shield though. It's a special shield that has the germ's **claw** cut off! ✂️ No sharp claw!

And it gives you a **tiny mark** on your shield so you know where the bad part went! 📝

Then you wait... wait... wait... until your shield gets mad at the mark! "Hey!" says your shield. "I'll get 'em!" And boom! You're safe now! 🎉

Your shield learns how to catch those mean germs! And now when they try to come back, your shield knows what to do! 🙌

That's why vaccines are good for you! They help your shield be strong and smart! 💪
